scope: Disposable deterministic production-model scenarios with canonical resource gathering, accepted reach/elevation/occlusion, clear standing-capsule approaches, resident route/work/water ledgers, and save reload. Movement between approaches is assigned through model actions. No live campaign/storage access. Model geometry checks are not a Rapier-controller traversal, browser visual approval, device frame-rate measurement, or multiplayer transport test.

lab.scope: Disposable deterministic production-model scenarios with canonical resource gathering, accepted reach/elevation/occlusion, clear standing-capsule approaches, resident route/work/water ledgers, and save reload. Movement between approaches is assigned through model actions. No live campaign/storage access. Model geometry checks are not a Rapier-controller traversal, browser visual approval, device frame-rate measurement, or multiplayer transport test.

checks.name: Earned finite raw materials
checks.expected: Every unit comes from a distinct reachable canonical source; repeated gathering adds nothing
checks.actual: 5 wood, 4 stone; 9 unique source IDs; minimum standing-body clearance 0.4800 m

checks.name: Delivery requires presence
checks.expected: A remote delivery is rejected before any stock allocation
checks.actual: Remote board action rejected

checks.name: Atomic bounded local delivery
checks.expected: Only the requested project cost is allocated; lifetime harvest counts stay unchanged
checks.actual: 4 wood + 3 stone delivered; 1 wood + 1 stone still available

checks.name: Duplicate delivery is inert
checks.expected: A satisfied project cannot consume the remaining pack
checks.actual: No state, stock or revision change

checks.name: Scaffold starts physical work
checks.expected: Paid construction exposes project geometry and requires resident work
checks.actual: 2 project shapes; 0 work ticks on start

checks.name: Duplicate start is inert
checks.expected: Repeated build commands never restart or complete construction
checks.actual: Second build start leaves the active project unchanged

checks.name: In-progress reload
checks.expected: Reload preserves construction work, residents and exact material allocation
checks.actual: 12.5 work ticks; 11937 campaign bytes

checks.name: Conserved caught water
checks.expected: Captured rain equals stored, carried, consumed and spilled water, with no unexplained creation
checks.actual: Residual -2.220e-16 L; consumed 2.000000 L equals resident drinking

checks.name: Resident construction completes
checks.expected: Resident route/work progression completes the paid catchment after nonzero simulated time
checks.actual: 48/48 work ticks; completed after 15 simulation seconds

checks.name: Rain reaches real resident needs
checks.expected: Residents collect catchment water, drink it and have less thirst than the same-time unbuilt control

checks.name: Completed tank replaces scaffold appearance
checks.expected: The completed project keeps its authorized physical envelope and changes construction material
checks.actual: 2 construction shapes → 2 completed shapes

checks.name: Leave, revisit and reload
checks.expected: Project, people, water and exhausted source records survive cache eviction and exact serialization
checks.actual: 11915 campaign bytes; 3476 supply-state bytes; exact round trip true

checks.name: Legacy plan is unchanged
checks.expected: Six new supply records reuse the original six outpost IDs; roads remain the original regional plan
checks.actual: 6 stable outpost IDs; 16 original roads

checks.name: Bounded state and geometry
checks.expected: Only six projects and twelve resident actors are persisted; supply payload stays below 20 KB
checks.actual: 3476 supply bytes; 12 actors; 2 active project colliders; 491.9 ms local CPU wall time

checks.name: Campaign isolation
checks.expected: The fixture did not mutate its starting campaign; no live state or storage is accepted by the API
checks.actual: Fresh isolated state remains unchanged

regionalTerrainPhysics.scope: Actual generated regional 3×3 terrain chunks, original shelter/tree/rock solids, production Rapier controller and new project colliders; actual unload/reload and persisted completed tank. No browser visual or device benchmark.
